title: MSME Idea Hackathon 6.0
shortDescription: The MSME Idea Hackathon 6.0, organized by the Entrepreneurship Cell (eCell) of MSIT on 12th August 2026 and 13th August 2026, provided a vibrant stage for innovative thinkers. Held under the Ministry of MSME, it aimed to inspire entrepreneurial ideas addressing real-world challenges. The event united students, faculty, and industry experts in a collaborative atmosphere. Its focus centered on sustainability, technology, and social innovation.
detailedDescription: The MSME Idea Hackathon 6.0 is a two-day celebration of innovation and creativity, bringing together student teams, startups, and innovators to showcase ideas in frontier technologies. The event was held on 12th August 2026 and 13th August 2026. The event opens with addresses from eminent guests and academic leaders who highlight the value of innovation, adaptability, and perseverance in entrepreneurship. Teams then present their projects to a panel of experts, with the strongest ideas eligible for funding support of up to ₹15 lakh, along with incubation and mentorship opportunities. By bridging academia and industry, the hackathon inspires students to turn their ideas into impactful ventures.

title: The E-Cell Orientation 2026
shortDescription: The Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell) of MSIT organized its Orientation Program on 27th August 2026. The event welcomed the new batch with a blend of fun, learning, and interaction. Through engaging activities, creative performances, and team introductions, students were immersed in the vibrant culture of E-Cell. The program aimed to inspire leadership, collaboration, and an innovative entrepreneurial mindset.
detailedDescription: The eCell MSIT Orientation is a warm welcome for freshers and prospective members, introducing them to eCell and its ecosystem. The session gives an overview of the society’s departments, flagship events, initiatives, and opportunities for growth. Interactive activities and games encourage freshers to bond with the core team and one another. The orientation aims to instill creativity, teamwork, and entrepreneurial passion, and marks the start of each new member’s journey with eCell MSIT.

title: The Startup Arena 2026

title: Envisage 4.0 2026
shortDescription: eCell MSIT successfully organized its annual flagship event, Envisage 4.0 2026, on the 21st of november 2026. The event served as a beacon of creativity, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit, providing a dynamic platform for students to present, discuss, and refine their business ideas under the theme 'Emerge. Explore. Evolve.'
detailedDescription:
eCell Maharaja Surajmal Institute of Technology (MSIT), successfully organized its annual flagship event, Envisage 4.0 2026, on the 31st of October 2025. The event once again served as a beacon of creativity, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit, providing a dynamic platform for students to present, discuss, and refine their business ideas.

We extend our sincere gratitude to Dr. Neeru Rathee, Convener of E-Cell MSIT, for her continuous guidance, cooperation, and encouragement throughout the planning and execution of the event. Her unwavering support has been instrumental in shaping Envisage into a platform that continues to nurture creativity and inspire innovation. The event was graced by the presence of an esteemed panel of judges, Ms. Harshika Drall, Mr. Shaurya Mishra (Former Vice President of E-Cell MSIT), Dr. Saurabh Trivedi, and Mr. Lakshay Chauhan, each of whom brought their vast experience and unique perspective to the evaluation process.

Adding further inspiration to the day, Mr. Saarthak Bakshi, Entrepreneur and CEO of RISSA IVF, joined as the guest speaker. His presence and powerful insights into entrepreneurship and leadership made the event even more enriching for the aspiring innovators in attendance. The theme for Envisage 2025 'Emerge. Explore. Evolve.' captured the essence of this vision, encouraging participants to think beyond boundaries and redefine possibilities. Powered by Aalisha Institute, the event continued the tradition of nurturing creativity, leadership, and enterprise within the student community.

PITCHING
The 25 shortlisted teams took turns presenting their entrepreneurial ideas before the panel of judges. Each team was evaluated on creativity, feasibility, innovation, and potential social or commercial impact. Participants presented diverse ideas ranging from AI-based solutions, healthcare innovations, and sustainable technologies to creative social ventures addressing educational and environmental issues. The atmosphere in the seminar hall was electric, as every team showcased passion, confidence, and originality in their presentations.

One of the standout projects was CareTales, an AI-powered storytelling platform designed for ill children. This project beautifully combined technology and empathy to bring joy and comfort to young patients through personalized stories generated by artificial intelligence. The concept captured the essence of socially responsible innovation and was highly appreciated by both the judges and the audience.

SPEAKER SESSION
The Envisage event featured an inspiring and thought-provoking session by Mr. Saarthak Bakshi, an accomplished entrepreneur and the CEO of RISSA IVF, who captivated the audience with his remarkable journey in the world of business and innovation. His insights into leadership, strategic thinking, and perseverance left a lasting impression on the participants.

WINNERS DECLARED
After careful evaluation based on innovation, feasibility, impact, and presentation, the judges announced the winners:
1st place - CodeX
2nd place - What the hack
3rd place - Aarogya Catalyst

CONCLUSION
Envisage 4.0 proved to be a monumental success, bringing together like-minded individuals passionate about innovation and growth. The event brought together aspiring entrepreneurs, mentors, and industry professionals, providing a dynamic platform for participants to showcase their innovative business ideas.

title: Bid To Build
shortDescription: An auction-style event where teams use virtual currency to bid on startup ideas and build a portfolio. The true market potential, competition, and funding needs are revealed afterwards, and the team with the highest portfolio value wins.
detailedDescription: Bid to Build is an engaging, auction-style event that turns startup investing into a strategic game. Teams receive a virtual currency and bid on a range of startup ideas, building their own portfolio with each successful bid. Once the auction ends, the real details of each idea are revealed, including its market potential, level of competition, and funding requirements. These details decide the true value of every portfolio, and the team with the highest portfolio value is crowned the winner. The event sharpens participants’ skills in evaluating ideas, making quick decisions under pressure, and managing risk, giving them a hands-on feel for how investors and founders think.

title: E-SUMMIT 2027
shortDescription: ECell MSIT, has successfully organized its annual flagship event, E-Summit 2027, a two-day entrepreneurial fest aimed at fostering innovation, creativity, and leadership among students. Hosted at the Maharaja Surajmal Institute of Technology (MSIT), the summit brought together aspiring entrepreneurs, industry experts, and creative minds on a common platform.
detailedDescription: E-SUMMIT 2026 Date: 10th – 11th February 2027  Time: 10:00 a.m. onwards Venue: MSIT Auditorium, 206 Seminar hall ECell MSIT, has successfully organized its annual flagship event, E-Summit 2026, a two-day entrepreneurial fest aimed at fostering innovation, creativity, and leadership among students. Hosted at the Maharaja Surajmal Institute of Technology (MSIT), the summit brought together aspiring entrepreneurs, industry experts, and creative minds on a common platform. The event revolved around the theme “Game of Throne,” symbolizing strategic thinking, leadership, and the pursuit of excellence in the entrepreneurial ecosystem. Through a diverse range of activities including speaker sessions, cultural programs, startup exhibitions, and competitive events, the summit provided participants with opportunities to learn, network, and showcase their talents.OPENING CEREMONY The inaugural session of E-Summit 2026 commenced at 10:00 a.m. at Maharaja Surajmal Institute of Technology under the guidance of convener Dr. Neeru Rathee and eCell faculty coordinators ( Dr. Shaily Malik, Dr. Sitender Malik, Dr. Rakhi Kamra and Dr. Rakesh Chikara). The event began with a warm welcome extended to the participants, faculty members, and distinguished guests. A ceremonial lamp lighting by Prof. (Dr.) Archana Balyan, Director MSIT along with Prof. (Dr.) Naveen Dahiya, Dean MSIT symbolized dedication, perseverance, and the pursuit of knowledge. The proceedings were further enriched by the invocation of Saraswati Vandana, creating a serene and auspicious atmosphere. Dr. Archana Balyan delivered an inspiring address,emphasizing entrepreneurship as a mindset and encouraging students to embrace risks and innovation. Dr. Mandeep Singh highlighted the growing importance of entrepreneurship in driving economic and societal progress, motivating students to become job creators. The session concluded with a recognition ceremony honoring the esteemed guests and a formal acknowledgment of Aalisha Institute for its valuable support. RANGMANCH – CULTURAL PROGRAM (DAY 1 & DAY 2) The Rangmanch Cultural Program, conducted across both days of E-Summit 2026 at Maharaja Surajmal Institute of Technology, served as a vibrant platform for showcasing the artistic talents of students through music, dance, and interactive segments. On Day 1, the program featured a captivating singing performance by Harsh Jha with songs, followed by an energetic dance performance by Tanisha, and a melodious duo act by Pranav and Ruchit. An engaging “Guess the Brand” quiz further added to audience participation. On Day 2, the program began with a musical performance by Dhun Vibers led by Sambhavi, which received enthusiastic audience response. This was followed by a dynamic dance performance by Riya Singh and a soulful piano performance by Shaurya Rao, both of which captivated the audience. The event was judged by Shaurya Mishra, Chief Advisor of eCell, and concluded with Harsh and Bhavyam being declared as the winners. Overall, Rangmanch across both days was marked by diverse performances and strong audience engagement, contributing significantly to the vibrant atmosphere of the summitECHOES OF INFLUENCE – SPEAKER SESSION The speaker session titled Echoes of Influence: Rising Empires Panel Discussion provided an insightful and interactive platform where distinguished panelists — Riya Jain, Founder of StractsbyRiya; Dr. Mitali Jaiswal, Founder of Life Sutra and SuicideFreeIndia; and Dr. Vassundara Nattes, Founder and Chairman as well as a Dadasaheb Phalke Award winner — shared valuable perspectives on entrepreneurship and personal growth. Hosted by Nandini, President of eCell, the session emphasized the importance of focusing on one's own journey rather than comparing with others. The panelists highlighted self-belief, discipline, and continuous learning as essential components of success, while also encouraging students to take initiative and act without waiting for ideal conditions. Entrepreneurship was presented as a journey requiring resilience, a strong mindset, and consistent effort. The session concluded with the felicitation of the panelists, expressing gratitude for their valuable insights and contributions.E-SUMMIT SHARK TANK 2026 The Shark Tank event brought together 15 selected teams who presented their startup ideas before esteemed judges including Dr. Sanjeen Sawhney, Entrepreneur, Harshit Khaneja, Vice President of eCell, and Mr. Kultar Singh along with Mrs. Narendra Kaur.in a competitive and intellectually stimulating environment. The event highlighted innovative concepts addressing contemporary challenges, with standout performances by Skill Drip, a reel-based learning platform aimed at productive skill development, and Safora, a safety system designed for women and children with real-time tracking capabilities. The session provided participants with valuable exposure, constructive feedback, and mentorship, fostering a culture of critical thinking and innovation. The competition witnessed a range of impactful ideas, and after thorough evaluation, Medivault secured the first position while Unsol emerged as the second runner-up, highlighting the strong entrepreneurial potential among participants. STARTUP EXPO 2026 The Startup Expo served as a dynamic platform for aspiring entrepreneurs to present innovative ideas and business models, creating an environment that closely resembled real-world entrepreneurial ecosystems. Organized in the outdoor areas of the campus, the Expo featured a wide range of student-led ventures spanning domains such as technology, social enterprise, and lifestyle solutions. Participants showcased their prototypes and concepts, followed by interactive discussions with evaluators who provided constructive feedback on feasibility, scalability, and market potential. The event attracted significant attention from attendees and played a crucial role in bridging the gap between academic knowledge and practical application. The initiative of facilitating Startup India registration for promising teams further demonstrated the commitment to nurturing entrepreneurial talent beyond the event.KEYNOTE SESSION – MR. VAIBHAV KANWAR The keynote session by Mr. Vaibhav Kanwar, Founder of Clapbox Music provided an insightful narrative of his entrepreneurial journey, illustrating the importance of identifying market gaps and taking initiative. He shared personal experiences from his early ventures, emphasizing responsibility, customer value, and learning from failures. His journey highlighted key lessons such as avoiding the creation of unnecessary problems, adapting to challenges, and prioritizing practical learning over theoretical knowledge. BID TO BUILD The Bid to Build event, conducted in Seminar Hall 206, provided a platform for students to address real-world challenges through innovative solutions. Judged by Mr. Amar Singh Bedi, an Amazon FBA coach, an experienced professional in the field of e-commerce, the event emphasized practical application and strategic thinking. Participants presented diverse ideas, including an AI-enabled mental health solution offering chatbot support, anonymous therapy, and mood tracking, as well as Skilldrip, a platform utilizing short-form content to provide career guidance in emerging fields. Each presentation was followed by detailed evaluation and feedback, enabling participants to refine their concepts. The event successfully encouraged innovation, critical thinking, and entrepreneurial problem-solving among students. The competition concluded with Ace, Baniya Monopoly, and Croissant Capital emerging as the winners, reflecting the creativity and practical thinking of the participating teams.CONCLUSION E-Summit 2026 emerged as a comprehensive and impactful event that successfully integrated entrepreneurship, innovation, and creativity over the course of two days. Through a combination of cultural programs, speaker sessions, startup exhibitions, and competitive events, the summit provided participants with valuable exposure to real-world challenges and opportunities. The event fostered an environment of collaboration, learning, and inspiration, encouraging students to think beyond conventional boundaries and pursue entrepreneurial aspirations. The collective efforts of the organizers, participants, speakers, judges, and sponsors contributed significantly to the success of the summit, reinforcing the commitment to nurturing future leaders and innovators.
